requirements.title: C_SIZEOF argument restrictions
requirements.definition: X is a data entity with interoperable type and type parameters; it is not an assumed-size array, an assumed-rank array associated with an assumed-size array, an unallocated allocatable, or a disassociated pointer.

pending.C_SIZEOF-X-interoperable-type-parameters: Guarded positive source controls first require C_INT > 0, C_DOUBLE > 0, or C_CHAR > 0 respectively before calling C_SIZEOF on INTEGER(C_INT), REAL(C_DOUBLE), and CHARACTER(KIND=C_CHAR,LEN=1) entities; mutation uses default derived type without BIND(C) and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_SIZEOF-X-not-assumed-size: Positive source control uses an explicit-shape or assumed-shape interoperable array; mutation passes an assumed-size dummy and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_SIZEOF-X-assumed-rank-not-associated-w: Positive source control forwards an explicit-shape actual to an assumed-rank dummy and calls C_SIZEOF; mutation forwards an assumed-size actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_SIZEOF-X-allocatable-allocated: Guarded positive source control first requires C_INT > 0, allocates INTEGER(C_INT), ALLOCATABLE :: x before C_SIZEOF(x); mutation omits allocation and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_SIZEOF-X-pointer-associated: Guarded positive source control first requires C_INT > 0, pointer-assigns INTEGER(C_INT), POINTER :: p => target before C_SIZEOF(p); mutation NULLIFYs p and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: C_SIZEOF returns a scalar C_SIZE_T integer
requirements.definition: The C_SIZEOF result is a scalar integer of kind C_SIZE_T.

pending.C_SIZEOF-result-integer-scalar: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0, assigns RANK(C_SIZEOF(0_C_INT)) to a sentinel initialized to -777, and asserts 0, proving the result itself is scalar; mutation uses an array-valued expression.
pending.C_SIZEOF-result-kind-c-size-t: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0 and C_SIZE_T > 0, assigns KIND(C_SIZEOF(0_C_INT)) to a sentinel initialized to -777, and asserts C_SIZE_T; mutation compares with KIND(0) only as a negative oracle mutation, not as a source fact.

requirements.title: C_SIZEOF scalar result matches companion C sizeof
requirements.definition: For scalar X, C_SIZEOF returns the companion C sizeof value for an object of a type interoperating with X.

pending.C_SIZEOF-scalar-c-int-sizeof: Guarded mixed Fortran/C plan first requires C_INT > 0 and C_SIZE_T > 0: C helper returns sizeof(int) as size_t; Fortran INTEGER(C_INT) :: x=17 compares C_SIZEOF(x) to the helper result, with x initialized distinctly from any size value.
pending.C_SIZEOF-scalar-c-double-sizeof: Guarded mixed plan first requires C_DOUBLE > 0 and compares C_SIZEOF of REAL(C_DOUBLE) scalar 1.5_C_DOUBLE to C helper sizeof(double); mutation calls the int helper to make the type mapping load-bearing.
pending.C_SIZEOF-scalar-c-char-sizeof: Guarded mixed plan first requires C_CHAR > 0 and compares C_SIZEOF of CHARACTER(KIND=C_CHAR,LEN=1) scalar 'A' to C helper sizeof(char), not to STORAGE_SIZE or a hard-coded byte width.

requirements.title: C_SIZEOF array result is element sizeof times element count
requirements.definition: For array X, C_SIZEOF returns the companion C sizeof value for one interoperating element type multiplied by the number of elements of X.

pending.C_SIZEOF-array-product-three-c-int: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0 and C_SIZE_T > 0; use INTEGER(C_INT) :: a(0:2)=[1,2,3]; compare C_SIZEOF(a) to 3_C_SIZE_T*C_SIZEOF(a(0)) and to C helper 3*sizeof(int); mutation expects the scalar size only.
pending.C_SIZEOF-array-product-two-by-two-c-doub: Guarded plan first requires C_DOUBLE > 0 and C_SIZE_T > 0; use REAL(C_DOUBLE) :: a(0:1,-1:0) with distinct exact values hand-derived in column-major order; compare C_SIZEOF(a) to 4_C_SIZE_T*C_SIZEOF(a(0,-1)); companion with rank-one two-element array asserts factor 2.
pending.C_SIZEOF-array-zero-size-product: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0 and C_SIZE_T > 0; use zero-size INTEGER(C_INT) array a(0), initialize a C_SIZE_T sentinel to 777_C_SIZE_T, and assert C_SIZEOF(a)==0_C_SIZE_T with a nonzero-size companion factor 3.
